name: Pectins
aliases: E440, E440(i), E440(ii), INS 440, pectin, pectins, non-amidated pectin, amidated pectin, amidated pectins
what_is: Pectin is what makes jam set. It is in fruit — mostly in lemon and orange peel, and in what is left of the apple after it has been pressed. That is where it is taken from, purified, and added to yoghurts, drinks, sweets and desserts to thicken them. On the label it is E440.
why_botia: In the French NutriNet-Santé observational cohort of 92,000 adults, higher E440 intake was associated with a higher incidence of premenopausal breast cancer (HR 1.55, 95% CI 1.12-2.14). This association does not establish causation and needs confirmation in further research. No statistically significant association was observed in postmenopausal women in this study. For E440, the finding concerns pectin consumed as a food additive, not pectin naturally present in fruit.
